The 'home' days on 7-8 and 10-11 could be sick leave or personal days. However, the consistency of Friday being a home day makes a fixed hybrid schedule more likely than random leave.
Low probability. The pattern is too regular (Mon-Thu office, Fri home) to be purely irregular. Kept as a fallback.
